keyEvents.text: Goal! RB Leipzig 1, Lens 0. David Raum (RB Leipzig) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! RB Leipzig 2, Lens 0. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Delay in match (RB Leipzig).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ismaëlo Ganiou (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Florian Sotoca (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, RB Leipzig 2, Lens 0.
Second Half begins RB Leipzig 2, Lens 0.
Goal! RB Leipzig 2, Lens 1. Matthieu Udol (Lens) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a fast break.
Matthieu Udol (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Brajan Gruda (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Rômulo replaces Brajan Gruda.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Ezechiel Banzuzi replaces Rocco Reitz.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Christopher Nkunku replaces Christoph Baumgartner.
Substitution, Lens. Mezian Mesloub replaces Abdallah Sima.
Substitution, Lens. Junior Kadile replaces Florian Sotoca.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Nicolas Seiwald replaces Maxime Estève.
Substitution, Lens. Michal Skóras replaces Saud Abdulhamid.
Michal Skóras (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Lens. Andrija Bulatovic replaces Amadou Haidara.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Andrija Maksimovic replaces Tidiam Gomis.
Neil El Aynaoui (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! RB Leipzig 3, Lens 1. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Christopher Nkunku following a fast break.
Second Half ends, RB Leipzig 3, Lens 1.
